root_cause.summary: The viewport created a new WebGL context on every stage mount. WebKit keeps an explicitly lost context in its 16-slot per-page active set until the context object is destroyed or garbage-collected; the 17th tracked context makes WebKit recycle the oldest, already-lost context, which prints both CI messages.

src/console/viewport/Viewport.tsx (pre-fix: a fresh R3F <Canvas> per mount)
